archetypes.name: dyn-token-attribution
archetypes.rationale: Step slicing now reroutes implementer raw rows and must not double count totals.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the token report changes around per-step slicing for Codex and Cursor implementer rows. Check that raw-labeled implementer rows are excluded from their wrong enclosing step, aggregated into Step 2 exactly once, and still included in vendor totals. Pay special attention to ledgers that already contain a Step 2 mark plus misplaced implementer rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
